sourceDiscovery.claim: In the tested construction model, cycle-closing redundant growth kept networks highly connected through four rounds of 20% random damage followed by regrowth, while the matched baseline fragmented much more strongly.
sourceDiscovery.boundary: This is evidence inside the tested computational construction model. It does not yet establish the same effect for every gameplay system or for targeted adversarial damage.

developmentHypothesis.statement: For gameplay systems whose useful behavior depends on a graph or network of paths, building alternate paths before failure will preserve function under targeted disruption better than relying on a single path or only repairing after failure.
developmentHypothesis.kidStatement: Если у важной штуки есть несколько дорожек, одна сломанная дорожка не должна всё остановить.
developmentHypothesis.predictedEffect: Applicable systems with deliberate alternate paths retain more of their task-specific function after targeted weak-point attacks than matched single-path baselines.
developmentHypothesis.baseline: Matched systems with the same budget but no deliberate alternate-path preference.
developmentHypothesis.failureCondition: The redundant variant fails its preregistered task-specific threshold, does not beat the matched baseline, or only succeeds because the attack/test can see privileged information unavailable in gameplay.
developmentHypothesis.confirmationRule: Freeze each applicable-system metric and threshold before hidden confirmation cases. Do not loosen them after results are visible.

vnoAudit.meaning: These scores measure how far the current RUN_072 evidence has progressed through the stricter VNO standard; they are not the percentage truth of a real-world law.

missing: more than six hidden confirmation seeds
frozen dependency/environment manifest attached to the run

passed: confirmation criteria explicitly forbid retuning after failure
missing: independent verifier that does not reuse implementation logic
formal ablation of the cycle-closing mechanism

vnoAudit.nextPriority: Independent clean-room reimplementation plus hidden targeted-damage confirmation.

gameplayTransfers.reason: World paths and connected regions form a graph-like system.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Новый мир старается делать не одну дорожку, а запасную тоже.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Generate optional looped corridors, bridges and region connections so a local break does not isolate a whole area.
gameplayTransfers.predictedEffect: More reachable world area remains after targeted route removal.
gameplayTransfers.baseline: Same connection budget without cycle preference.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Measure reachable-region ratio after random and highest-importance route cuts on hidden seeds.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Remove the most central links first and search for seeds where redundant generation isolates more area than baseline.

gameplayTransfers.reason: Progress can depend on routes to scarce resource nodes.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Если одна шахта недоступна, у мира должна быть другая дорога к нужной штуке.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Distribute critical-resource access so progression is not dependent on one chokepoint.
gameplayTransfers.predictedEffect: A larger fraction of required resources remains reachable after targeted terrain blockage.
gameplayTransfers.baseline: Matched resource count with unconstrained placement/access.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Block high-centrality access cells and compare reachable critical resources.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Target the nearest or most-used resource corridor and test scarcity edge cases.

gameplayTransfers.reason: RUN_071/072 directly concerns connected built structures.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Дом крепче, когда важные части держатся не только за одну опору.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Preview structural layouts that favor alternate support/connectivity loops before damage.
gameplayTransfers.predictedEffect: More structure remains connected and usable after targeted support removal.
gameplayTransfers.baseline: Original local frontier construction rule with matched build budget.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Add targeted support/bridge removal to the existing RUN_072-style harness before runtime promotion.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Remove highest-betweenness or articulation-like supports first.

gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Если мост сломан, должна остаться дорога в обход.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Road growth prefers useful loops and alternate routes rather than dead-end-only expansion.
gameplayTransfers.predictedEffect: NPC/player destinations remain reachable after targeted road closure.
gameplayTransfers.baseline: Matched road length without loop preference.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Compare destination reachability and detour cost after bridge/central-road removal.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Cut the busiest/most central road segments.

gameplayTransfers.reason: Navigation and squad behavior can have alternate action/path choices, but this is a transfer hypothesis, not established by RUN_072.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Если врагу закрыли один путь, он попробует другой, а не застрянет.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Enemy navigation/behavior preview with bounded fallback routes or roles when a preferred route is blocked.
gameplayTransfers.predictedEffect: Fewer enemies become permanently stuck or useless after targeted path disruption.
gameplayTransfers.baseline: Single preferred route/behavior with the same navigation budget.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Block preferred routes on hidden maps and measure task completion, stuck rate and path cost.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Block the highest-use waypoint and construct narrow-map counterexamples.

gameplayTransfers.reason: Weapons provide distinct disruption patterns that can test whether redundancy helps under more than random damage.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Разные выстрелы ломают мир по-разному. Мир должен выдерживать не только лёгкие поломки.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Give damage types different bounded shapes so players can test weak points, bridges and concentrated damage.
gameplayTransfers.predictedEffect: Redundant structures retain more function than baseline across multiple weapon damage geometries.
gameplayTransfers.baseline: Matched structures under the same weapon damage budget.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Define projectile/area/line damage fixtures and compare post-hit connectivity/function.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Aim damage at algorithmically selected structural weak points.

gameplayTransfers.reason: Damage is the direct stressor in RUN_072 and needs stronger adversarial variants.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Мы не просто ломаем случайный кубик. Мы ищем самое больное место.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Add targeted damage test modes and player-visible weak-point challenge scenarios.
gameplayTransfers.predictedEffect: The redundant rule still beats baseline under preregistered targeted damage classes.
gameplayTransfers.baseline: Identical damage classes against non-redundant growth.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Bridge, center, concentrated, high-connectivity and sequential weak-point damage fixtures.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Search automatically for the smallest targeted removal that fragments the redundant structure.

gameplayTransfers.reason: Alternate supports and routes can affect physical reachability, but must be verified against actual physics rather than graph score alone.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: После поломки игрок всё ещё должен уметь пройти и не провалиться.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Physics validation for damaged/regrown structures: walkability, support, collision and step-up remain correct.
gameplayTransfers.predictedEffect: Graph resilience corresponds to real playable reachability without collision regressions.
gameplayTransfers.baseline: Undamaged and matched baseline damaged structures.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Run behavioral movement/collision fixtures over damaged and regrown geometry.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Find cases with high graph connectivity but impossible player movement.

gameplayTransfers.reason: Animation state graphs can test the broader alternate-path hypothesis independently of world geometry.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Если одно движение прервалось, герой не должен застыть как статуя.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Experimental animation-state fallback transitions for interrupted or unavailable states.
gameplayTransfers.predictedEffect: Characters recover to a valid visible state more often after targeted transition removal/interruption.
gameplayTransfers.baseline: Matched state graph without fallback transition preference.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Remove/disable selected transitions in test graphs and measure valid-state recovery.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Disable the highest-use transition and search for loops, freezes or impossible poses.

gameplayTransfers.reason: Only as a new transfer hypothesis: local environment state transitions can be modeled as alternate paths, but RUN_072 does not yet validate weather.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Погода не должна зависнуть навсегда из-за одного сломанного перехода.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Prototype weather/environment state graphs with safe alternate transitions and local recovery paths.
gameplayTransfers.predictedEffect: Environment cycles continue through valid states after targeted transition loss without abrupt impossible jumps.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Fault-inject transition/state removal and measure valid progression and visual continuity.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Remove the most central transition and test extreme sequences.

gameplayTransfers.reason: Effects can explain damage and recovery but RUN_072 does not imply that redundant effect graphs improve gameplay resilience.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Пыль и вспышки помогают увидеть поломку, но сами не доказывают правило.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Keep effects as honest feedback for applicable mechanics; do not claim a scientific transfer.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Only regression/performance checks for feedback accuracy.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Ensure effects cannot make a failed mechanic look successful.

gameplayTransfers.reason: Surface appearance is not a path-connectivity mechanism; it may visualize history but is not evidence for the hypothesis.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Царапина на стене может показать историю, но не делает стену крепче сама по себе.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Optional scars/history visuals only after the underlying mechanic is verified.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Visual truthfulness and performance regression only.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Check that cosmetic state cannot be counted as structural recovery.

gameplayTransfers.reason: Audio communicates state but is not itself evidence that alternate paths preserve function.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Звук может сказать: «сломалось», но звук сам ничего не починил.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Use audio only as truthful feedback if/when an applicable mechanic changes state.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Feedback timing/accessibility checks when audio exists.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Verify sound never fires without the real state change.

gameplayTransfers.reason: Progression can be a dependency graph where a single required route creates a chokepoint.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Если один способ получить важную вещь пропал, игра может оставить другой честный способ.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Prototype alternate progression/resource routes for critical goals without duplicating rewards uncontrollably.
gameplayTransfers.predictedEffect: More valid progression remains after one route is disabled, without reducing challenge or inflating rewards.
gameplayTransfers.baseline: Single-route critical progression with matched reward budget.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Disable a critical source/path and measure reachable goals plus economy inflation.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Remove the easiest/most-used route and search for exploits caused by redundancy.

gameplayTransfers.reason: Navigator is the communication layer. It must explain VNO outcomes but must not be used as evidence for the gameplay hypothesis.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Я просто объясняю, что случилось. Я не притворяюсь доказательством.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Always show age-5 truthful explanation of whether a feature is an idea, experiment or verified runtime behavior.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Validate age-5 copy and evidence-boundary wording.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Reject wording that calls a plan or preview proven.

gameplayTransfers.reason: Multiple players create concurrent paths/actions and can test whether resilient structures remain shared and consistent under disruption.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Если вы строите вместе, запасные пути должны быть одинаковыми для всех игроков.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Shared authoritative resilient-network changes with deterministic conflict handling and visible group recovery.
gameplayTransfers.predictedEffect: All peers converge on the same surviving/regrown network state after concurrent damage.
gameplayTransfers.baseline: Existing authoritative state without the new transfer mechanic.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Concurrent damage/regrowth fixtures verify convergence, deduplication and no phantom blocks.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Race two players breaking/restoring adjacent weak points and inject reordered events.

gameplayTransfers.reason: A resilient mechanic is only real gameplay if damage/regrowth history survives reload and does not reconstruct impossible state.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Мир должен помнить, что ты сломал и что потом выросло.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Persist causal damage/regrowth history needed to reproduce the same world state after reload.
gameplayTransfers.predictedEffect: Reloaded worlds preserve the same authoritative network and causal history.
gameplayTransfers.baseline: Current persisted voxel state with no new hidden local-only state.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Replay/reload deterministic history and compare state hashes plus event provenance.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Interrupt between damage and regrowth, reload, and verify no duplicated or lost effects.

gameplayTransfers.reason: Performance is a mandatory non-regression constraint, not evidence that the scientific topology claim transfers.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Новая умная штука не должна делать игру тормозной.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Budget every VNO gameplay slice and block promotion if CPU, memory, network or frame-time regress materially.
gameplayTransfers.predictedEffect: N/A as scientific transfer; performance must remain within accepted budgets.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Existing quality/performance gates plus feature-specific load measurements.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Worst-case dense damage/regrowth/event bursts on constrained profiles.

methodUpgradesFromCycle: Added a canonical 18-system gameplay map so no major game area is silently skipped.
Added explicit NOT_APPLICABLE as a valid outcome so VNO never forces fake cross-domain confirmation.
Every applicable transfer now requires its own baseline, code test and falsification attack before promotion.
VNO targets the weakest pillar first; RUN_072 currently prioritizes independent clean-room replication.
Player-facing explanations remain separate from internal scientific evidence and use age-5 Russian wording.

nextLoop.firstAction: Freeze a targeted-damage protocol and give a clean-room replicator only the written rule/specification, not the original implementation.
